item.title: Apple Settles Siri AI Delay Lawsuit for $250M
item.description: Apple gains preliminary court approval for a $250 million settlement, offering up to $95 per eligible iPhone owner after the delayed Siri AI launch.

item.title: Apple’s $250 Million Siri Settlement Approved
item.description: Apple’s $250 million Siri privacy settlement has been approved, detailing the payout structure and its ripple effects across tech, law, and AI.
